commit_message: Expose ADR0127 Native2D MCP typed-document tools
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body: Fixes the exact Native 2D MCP capability coverage failure on the current ADR0127 head while preserving the newly added proving template. Sprite Atlas, Sprite Animation, Tile Set, and Tile Map descriptors now derive from the canonical capability registry, and existing headless handlers are covered by inventory tests.
